about.text: Free iOS/iPadOS app on the China App Store (title 峡谷数据 - 上分有迹可循, 'Real-time records, champion strength, ranked analysis'): champion win rates, builds and runes, counters and synergies by role and rank, summoner lookup with KDA and win rate, rank leaderboards, live-game lineups and LCK/LPL esports schedules; no sign-in; data from public APIs, unaffiliated with Riot.

pricing.text: Free (App Store: no registration, all features free).
